notes: Regional wording for spec/greetings (model: research-d33-d37-b5.md A3). `animals`: the word for {yearAnimal} by year chi (0 = Tý … 11 = Hợi); `animalsByRegion` overrides it for a reader region. `markers`: words that tie a text to a region — an item with region null contains none, an item with a region contains only markers that list it (test-checked). Matching is on whole words, case-insensitive.

`cậu` (v0.15.5) is a Bắc marker only as the pronoun between friends (tớ / cậu). As a kinship word (cậu = the mother's brother, cậu mợ) it is used in every region. In this library the test reads every "cậu" as Bắc, so a shared, Trung or Nam item does not use it, not even for the uncle. A check on free text (the AI greeting's region filter, backend `greetings/library.ts` `MARKERS`) must leave `cậu` out: there it is not a reliable marker.
